# Smart Ralph spec workflow (Zach)

Guides spec-driven development from research to task-by-task implementation.

- Source: https://github.com/tzachbon/smart-ralph
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tzachbon/smart-ralph/main/plugins/ralph-specum/skills/spec-workflow/SKILL.md
- Author: Zach
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/smart-ralph-spec-workflow-zach-1a124f9f

Explains the Smart Ralph flow: research, requirements, design and task phases each produce a Markdown file, and an executor agent then implements the tasks one by one with commits. Normal mode pauses for approval between phases, quick mode runs them all. Large features can be split into an epic of dependent specs. It points to the plugin's commands, such as /ralph-specum:start and /ralph-specum:triage.

**Try asking:**
- "Start a spec for adding OAuth login"
- "Triage this large billing rewrite into smaller specs"
- "What phase is my current spec in, and what is next?"

**Source:** [tzachbon/smart-ralph](https://github.com/tzachbon/smart-ralph/tree/HEAD/plugins/ralph-specum/skills/spec-workflow) · MIT · by Zach
